title: 2x Courgette 'Tristan' Plug Plants | Patio & Container Variety
description: This is a reliable and heavy-cropping variety, producing an abundance of succulent, dark-green cylindrical fruits. It has an excellent flavour and is an RHS 'Plants for Pollinators' variety, making it great for attracting bees to your garden. Key Features: Variety: Courgette 'Tristan' Fruit: Dark-green, cylindrical. Best picked when 20cm long. Yield: Heavy cropping. Regular harvesting extends the season.
